Once those three findings are entered, I can make my approval decision under the filing review process. But I want to be clear: I will not approve until all three findings are formally recorded, and I will only approve if we can credibly meet the 12-page, incorporation-by-reference scope, honor the client's anonymity, and satisfy the consent and screening obligations before Friday's deadline.
